newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares weaken under pressure from U.S.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares weaken under pressure from U.S.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse ended down on Friday under pressure from losses on Wall Street and a slide in forestry companies.
The bourse's general index closed 0.32 percent lower at 1,980.85 after turnover of 2.9 billion crowns.
The U.S. market would continued to steer the market, brokers said.

Forestry shares fell sharply on profit taking and a warning by HSBC James Capel that it was reducing its forecasts for the paper industry across the board and that an expected industry recovery may not be realised.
"I see it mostly as a reaction to the recent gains," said Andreas Nyberg, an analyst at Skandiabanken.

MoDo dropped 8.50 crowns to 191.50 and SCA fell 2.50 crowns to 140.50. Meanwhile pulp producer Sodra said it planned to raise the price of pulp to $630 per tonne in October from the current price of $580.
Drug company Astra and telecoms group Ericsson suffered from general market pessimism. Astra sank 3.50 crowns to 280 and Ericsson fell 2.50 crowns to 154.50.
Volvo rose three crowns to 141 in line with U.S. gains.
